run_stale_issue_closer: run the stale.py script to automatically mark and close stale GitHub issues
review_main_function: review the main function that iterates open issues and marks stale ones with labels
refactor_stale_detection_logic: refactor the stale detection logic to customize the 23 day inactivity and 30 day age thresholds
update_exempt_labels: update the LABELS_TO_EXEMPT list to add or remove labels that prevent issues from being marked stale
modify_stale_comment_template: modify the stale notification comment template posted by the script on inactive issues
